Those requirements belong to the AS degree, so no blocks are recorded for the certificate. A reviewer should find the CA Technical section, likely on another catalog page.

The AS section's description says 'An AS degree and certificate program are offered.' Its Program Learning Outcomes are printed under the AS heading: 'Communicate design concepts clearly and concisely (i.e. visual, oral, and written).', 'Develop competitive industry standard skills in the respective fields.', and 'Understand the elements and principles of design through discipline-specific implementation.' They are left out of outcomes because the certificate's own section is not in the text. Check whether the certificate shares them.
The description mentions 'employment in an apparel design firm' or starting 'their own business', but names no specific career titles, so careers is empty.
The text at the top of page 186 ends a different program (Total Required Major Units: 18 with FASH 151/225/226). It is not the Technical certificate, since the Technical sections follow it.
